outputs.summary: Every non-deleted chat is listed under its agent type in the sidebar AGENTS section (expandable rows, folder name or "No project" label, live dot, sign-in badge, open/rename/delete via existing dialogs), and each agent row can summon a project-less chat through the first-prompt popup. ChatRecord.folder is nullable; project-less chats live in userData/agents/chats/projectless and run in a per-chat scratch folder userData/agents/scratch/<chatId>, removed on delete. New chats:listAll (main, IPC, preload) lists every tracked folder plus project-less chats. Dark Mechanicus access for project-less chats (wide open, as the person decided): one ordinary server-issued orchestrator+Allow save grant per tracked, set-up folder, each token in a private file passed via the existing --token-file flag, checked by the normal command layer (cross-folder token refused), revoked on terminal exit, chat deletion and agent removal; with no tracked folder the chat starts without access. Folders tracked after start are reached on the next start. README, docs/runbooks/agents.md and docs/design/chat-shells.md document it, including the access risk.
